# CI selection runs single-app NL specs without a Brain checkout

Part of #20370 (linked natively); graduated from D#18775 (fold leaf 4, STEP_BACK points 5 and 6). Blocked by the adapter leaf.

## Context

`test/playwright/externalBrainSelection.mjs` excludes any e2e spec whose text contains the token `neuralLink` when no Brain checkout is configured. At Engine `1bb05f5426` that is 128 of 195 spec files (Euclid's STEP_BACK on D#18775). Once the adapter runs single-app specs without a Bridge, most of them no longer need that exclusion.

## The Architectural Reality

- `externalBrainSelection.mjs:41` decides by a text match; its unit spec is `test/playwright/unit/test/externalBrainSelection.spec.mjs`.
- `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs` selects hosted e2e specs; its unit spec is `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/E2eCiSelection.spec.mjs`.
- Two active owners border this: #20330 (under #20328) decides which specs a PR's change can reach, and #19655 owns the Bridge/headed tier in hosted CI.

## The Fix

Mark which specs are adapter-eligible (single app, dedicated worker, no physical window journey, no recorder) with an explicit, documented predicate, and select those without a Brain checkout. Bridge-shaped specs stay Brain-gated.

## Discussion Criteria Mapping & Leaf Slice

<!-- binding-inventory: ci-selection -->
- `test/playwright/externalBrainSelection.mjs`
- `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs`
<!-- /binding-inventory -->

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] On one committed tree, the PR records the eligible and the actually selected populations before and after: Brain-gated, adapter-eligible, and selected per tier.
- [ ] The adapter-eligible predicate is explicit and documented in `externalBrainSelection.mjs`'s JSDoc, not inferred from incidental text.
- [ ] Native, SharedWorker and Bridge-shaped specs stay Brain-gated, each under its named owner (#19655, or the SharedWorker residual leaf).
- [ ] #20330's reach classification is untouched; the PR body names the boundary it leaves to #20330 and to #19655.
- [ ] Both unit specs cover the new predicate.
- [ ] *(post-merge)* The next hosted `dev` run selects the recorded number of additional specs.

## Out of Scope

Which specs a change can reach (#20330), the Bridge tier's runner (#19655), and SharedWorker eligibility.
